summaries.Good news: Real human connection and institutional care are saving lives: from a flood warning that saved 900 students to a stray cat becoming a beloved stationmaster, to systems redesign putting mental health support directly in reach. Progress happens when people show up for each other.
summaries.Ideas: AI is reshaping power dynamics across industries—from who gets to say 'no' in engineering to how designers maintain agency—while workers are finding that friction and ostracism matter more than we realized for creativity and wellbeing.
summaries.Technology: Electric vehicles are finally looking normal instead of futuristic, autonomous systems are arriving in real cities, and breakthrough materials science is quietly solving real problems from bike lubrication to optical sensing.
summaries.Design: From a beautifully functional saute pan lid to a reimagined Obama Presidential Center, design is proving itself in both intimate details and monumental civic architecture—while new designers are pushing material experimentation and the simple gesture of good doorstop design.
